title: Jazz Limited in Chicago and the guitarist Mike
summary: He worked at Jazz Limited in Chicago and recalls an older versatile guitarist named Mike.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I took a fellow named Mike, he was a very versatile man like me. He played guitar in bands and sang, and he was older than me. He was down here when Louis Armstrong came to me on you somewhere in the 30 and played somewhere out there in the middle.
And you were playing banjo at this time?
